title: Riddle
html_source: Lenehan is a warning: the parallels with Stephen so far (the riddle, the reference to Pyrrhus, the role of jester among his betters) show what Stephen might become if he does not find a ‘father’. Similarly the poem he develops here from the draft in chapter 3 is a dead end; he has yet to find his own voice and will timidly try out the Parable before the chapter ends.
